name: Sri Bhu Varahaswamy Temple
location: North Bank of Swami Pushkarini, Tirumala
significance: Adi Kshetra deity who granted land to Lord Venkateswara. Tradition dictates worshipping Sri Varahaswamy first before Lord Venkateswara.

name: Sri Bedi Anjaneya Swamy Temple
significance: Lord Hanuman with handcuffed hands (Bedi) placed by mother Anjana Devi to protect pilgrims permanently.

name: Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple
significance: The primary divine consort of Lord Venkateswara. Visiting Tiruchanur completes the Tirupati pilgrimage.

name: Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple
significance: Elder brother of Lord Venkateswara who managed the wedding finances; depicts Lord Vishnu in Sayana (reclining) posture.

name: Sri Kapileswara Swamy Temple
location: Kapila Theertham, foot of Tirumala Hills, Tirupati
significance: The only ancient Shiva temple in Tirupati, located at the sacred mountain waterfall.

name: Sri Kalyana Venkateswara Swamy Temple
significance: Where Lord Venkateswara and Goddess Padmavathi stayed for six months after marriage; renowned for marriage boons.

name: Sri Kodandaramaswamy Temple
significance: Commemorating the return of Lord Rama, Sita Devi, and Lakshmana from Lanka.

name: Sri Prasanna Venkateswara Swamy Temple
significance: Lord in Abhaya Hasta granting fearless protection to devotees.

name: Sri Veda Narayanaswamy Temple
significance: Ancient shrine dedicated to the Matsya Avatar (Fish incarnation) of Lord Vishnu.

name: Sri Venugopalaswamy Temple
significance: Dedicated to Lord Sri Krishna with Rukmini Devi and Satyabhama.
